summary: The discussion centers on adding a logical VECTOR type to Parquet to represent fixed-length numeric vectors The discussion proposes a two‑tier approach to Parquet format changes: add‑everywhere changes that are forward compatible and can be adopted at any pace, and compatibility‑level changes that require readers to fail early if they do not support the new level. This aims to accelerate feature rollout while ensuring readers either correctly interpret data or fail safely. Andrew Lamb opened a discussion to rally contributors for adding new encodings to Parquet, citing existing work such as pcode, FSST, and PFOR. Participants noted active threads on PFOR and FSST/OnPair string encodings, and the process for extending the Parquet spec has been clarified.
